newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks close higher, sentiment improves.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks close higher, sentiment improves.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks closed higher on Monday amid improved economic sentiment, brokers said.
The all share index closed 0.91 points higher at 608.04. Commercial Bank rose two rupees to 130, Tea Smallholder one to 26.75.
"Many low-priced shares that retail investors go for are still available, but the pricey blue chips have dried up," said Dimuthu Abeysekera a broker at Allied Phillips Securities.
Overall sentiment has improved since investors expect good corporate growth in 1997, brokers said.
